label: News summary
output: Here is a summary in 64 words: Anne Frank died of typhus at the age of 15. New research suggests she died before February 7, 2022, at least a month earlier than the long-accepted date of March 31, 1945. The Bergen-Belsen camp was liberated two weeks later, and seventy years on, researchers examined 1,200 archive records.
sources: Seventy years ago, Anne Frank died of typhus in a Nazi concentration camp at the age of 15. Just two weeks after her supposed death on March 31, 1945, the Bergen-Belsen concentration camp where she had been imprisoned was liberated. New research shows that Anne and her older sister, Margot, died at least a month earlier than previously thought; witnesses said both had symptoms before February 7.
